_doc.shape: flat pool of questions, no graph. each node has a `topic` (one of `topics`) and lives in that topic group in the editor. `openers` (in order) run first; everything else is investigator-pickable.
_doc.answer_tuple: [answer_text] | [answer_text, comment]. comment is shown inline after the user picks that answer.
_doc.substitution: any {field} in question or comment text is replaced with profile.field at render time. supported: {name}, {sun_sign}, {birth_card}, {life_path}, {age_bracket}.
_doc.fmt_values: text | date | choice | binary | multi | matrix
_doc.interp: per-answer interpretation hints for the observer agent. keyed as 'node_id.answer_text'. not used for branching.
_doc.todo_text_followup: some answers (e.g. three_am.someone) want a follow-up text entry to capture the specific noun. not yet schema-supported; planned as an `expand?: true` flag on the tuple or a sibling `followups` map. for now the answer stands alone.

interp.vibe_grid.calm + in head: self-contained, possibly ruminating. low affect surface — probe gently.
interp.vibe_grid.chaotic + in head: spiraling alone. high internal activity, low external anchor. most likely to have live material.
interp.whats_true.something is unsaid: communication withheld. cross with relational picks.
interp.whats_true.something is ending: active transition. loss or relief or both.
interp.whats_true.something is starting: new thing live. may be hope or anxiety.
interp.whats_true.something is finally good: relief or arrival. if alone, may still have live material elsewhere.
interp.whats_true._meta: 0_checked=avoidance or genuinely nothing live. 1_checked=focused; follow the thread. 2-3=typical; combos matter. 4+=overwhelmed or undifferentiated.
interp.whats_true._combos: stuck+unsaid=almost certainly a person. ending+starting=transition with grief and hope. too much+stuck=paralysis. finally good + anything negative=good thing fragile, other thing is real topic.
interp.creature.raven: observer, thinker, possibly isolated. attracted to meaning-making.
interp.creature.serpent: self-aware, strategic, guarded. knows more than they let on.
interp.creature.cat: self-sufficient, curious, on their own terms. may resist being read.
interp.creature.moth: drawn to what could hurt them. attraction-to-danger pattern. romantic in a self-destructive register.
interp.creature.pigeon: self-effacing or ironically humble. comfortable in the unremarkable. possibly underselling.
interp.creature.rabbit: flight-prone, hyperaware, reads the room before acting. anxiety-adjacent.
interp.putting_off.a conversation: relational stasis. specific person almost certainly exists.
interp.putting_off.a decision: fork is live and unresolved. seer's primary material.
interp.putting_off.a task: lowest signal unless paired with too much.
interp.putting_off.i'm not: denial or genuine clarity. watch subsequent picks for contradiction.
interp.who_in_head.someone i love: relational warmth active — anchor or anxiety source.
interp.who_in_head.someone i'm avoiding: active conflict. strong candidate for unsaid thread.
interp.who_in_head.someone i've lost: grief or estrangement. handle with care.
interp.real_version.none: significant isolation. pairs strongly with myself on honesty.
interp.honesty_target.myself: self-deception acknowledged — high self-awareness or high avoidance.
interp.honesty_target.someone close: specific dishonesty. likely same person as postponed conversation.
interp.honesty_target.no one: either genuine or defensive. check against unsaid.
interp.decision_style.logic: analytical — may be in their head about whatever's live.
interp.decision_style.avoid them: decision-avoidant — fork is probably why they're here.
interp.like_yourself.not especially: low self-regard openly admitted. high signal; handle gently.
interp.keep_score.depends what for: selective accounting — usually means yes for one specific domain (often relational or financial).
interp.crisis_response.go quiet: internalizer — material unlikely to surface easily.
interp.crisis_response.fix things: problem-solver — may avoid sitting with feelings.
interp.three_am.someone: person-fixation at night — cast member is active.
interp.three_am.something i didn't do: omission regret — possibly the postponed conversation.
interp.what_protect.my image: social-self primary. reputation as the load-bearing thing.
interp.what_protect.my independence: autonomy as core value. relational entanglement reads as threat.
interp.want_cards_to_say.go: pull toward exit or change — held back by fear.
interp.want_cards_to_say.wait: uncertainty tolerable but waiting for signal.
interp.how_seen.reliable: prosocial self-image — may suppress own needs.
interp.how_seen.unpredictable: either variable or romanticizes being unreadable.
interp.self_describe.someone who tries: effort-as-identity. may carry quiet exhaustion. cross with work_feeling.
interp.self_describe.someone who holds back: explicit self-aware containment. there is something specific being held.
interp.self_describe.someone who adapts: high self-monitor. shape changes by context — true self may be unclear even to them.
interp.self_describe.someone who doesn't quite: outsider self-concept. either chronic or current.
interp.honesty_grid.honest + not okay: self-aware and struggling. most open to seer's work.
interp.honesty_grid.performing + not okay: performing while suffering. the gap is the story.
interp.live_in_time.all at once, which is its o: temporally diffuse. usually anxious or pattern-saturated.
interp.change_mind.i try not to: explicit anti-revision stance. high signal — identity-rigid or value-driven.
interp.change_direction.more certain: consolidation phase. either grounded growth or premature foreclosure.
interp.change_direction.more uncertain: dissolution phase. open and possibly destabilized.
interp.change_direction.harder: edges sharpened. self-protective trajectory; may carry recent injury.
interp.change_direction.softer: edges loosened. either grown or worn down — check tone elsewhere.
interp.change_direction.not much, honestly: stable or stagnant. depends on age/context.
interp.tarot_familiarity.yes — i'm into it: believer or invested. seer can be more reverent. they'll catch unforced theatrics.
interp.tarot_familiarity.once or twice: neutral curiosity. open but not committed.
interp.tarot_familiarity.not really: first-timer. baseline calibration; seer leans into theatrical pacing.
interp.tarot_familiarity.i don't believe in it: skeptic. seer should lean into irony, embrace doubt. don't over-promise.
interp.moment_to_share.something i'm proud of: positive self-narrative active. note what they share.
interp.moment_to_share.something i can't explai: interesting. either mystical-inclined or genuinely confused.
interp.moment_to_share.i'd rather not say: the question landed. note as decline.
interp.intent.has_initial: user typed a question at the start. surveyors should sharpen around it (without restating it back too literally).
interp.intent.dont_know: user came in with no question. survey works harder to surface what's actually live for them.
interp.birth_time.morning: early-bird tendency; astrology gets ascending sign emphasis.
interp.birth_time.i don't know: skip rising-sign details; lean on sun + life path.
interp.work_feeling.meaningful: occupational alignment. not a fork candidate; anchor.
interp.work_feeling.fine: neutral surface. probe for what's underneath.
interp.work_feeling.a slog: occupational drag. strong candidate for the Choice fork.
interp.work_feeling.undefined: work-role unclear or in flux. transitional.
interp.alt_life.doing something specific: alt-life is named. potent — what's stopping them. (note: text-followup not yet captured; surface as a thread for the seer to ask about live.)
interp.alt_life.not sure: identity outside current role is undeveloped.
interp.body_feel.stomach: dread or hidden knowledge — gut-area somatization.
interp.body_feel.throat: swallowed words. unsaid thread strongly indicated.
interp.body_feel.nowhere lately: dissociation, numbing, or actual ease. cross with anxiety_tell.
interp.parents_version.accurate: rare; either genuinely close or hasn't changed much.
interp.parents_version.outdated: growth that hasn't been transmitted home. common.
interp.parents_version.curated: deliberate management of parental view. there's something specific being hidden.
interp.parents_version.unknown to them: significant divergence between presented self and origin. cast: parents.
interp.live_here.no, but i stay: geographic stuckness. the staying is the question.
interp.would_rather_be.somewhere specific: named alternative location. potent — what holds them here.
interp.would_rather_be.nowhere: rooted, or unable to imagine elsewhere.
interp.would_rather_be.anywhere but here: active aversion to current location. urgency.
interp.you_make.yes — i make: creative identity active. ask what they make at reading time.
interp.you_make.yes, but i don't call it that: creative work disowned. self-perception lags reality.
interp.you_make.not really: no current creative outlet. neutral — not all lives have one.
interp.you_make.i used to: creative loss. specific kind of grief. probe what changed.
interp.destination_map.destination, no map: outcome-driven; knows what they want, not how. faith over plan. often acts first, figures it out en route. fork tends to be 'which destination', not 'whether to go'.
interp.destination_map.map, no destination: process-driven; skill-rich without aim. existential drift. the 'good at things but lost' pattern. fork tends to be identity/meaning, not logistics. high risk of competence-as-avoidance.
interp.self_deception.that it's fine: minimization. catastrophic equanimity. usually fronted; something is not fine.
interp.self_deception.that i don't mind: stated indifference about something they very much mind. probe.
interp.self_deception.that i'll deal with it la: active deferral. paired with putting_off this is a strong fork signal.
interp.self_deception.that they don't know: third-party-belief-management. usually wrong; the other person knows.
interp.disappear.get busy: task-flooding as avoidance. workaholic-adjacent. work_feeling probably 'fine' or 'a slog'.
interp.disappear.go very quiet: withdrawal as default. relational invisibility is the coping mode.
interp.disappear.find someone: co-regulation seeker. may use intimacy to avoid solitude with self.
interp.disappear.i don't, really: stays in the heat. either resilient or unable to retreat — check stress signs elsewhere.
interp.anxiety_tell.face: anxiety leaks through expression. probably can't mask it even when trying.
interp.anxiety_tell.hands: somatic externalizer — fidget, gesture. body knows before mind does.
interp.anxiety_tell.silence: anxiety drops the voice. introvert-coded or trauma-coded.
interp.anxiety_tell.they can't: high-masking. internal world unreadable from outside — either trained or fortified.
interp.pull_away.you don't — you stay too long: anti-withdrawal. over-stays — possibly past damage threshold. enmeshment risk.
interp.contradiction.how much i care: caring-as-vulnerability. wants to be seen as caring but flinches at being known to care.
interp.contradiction.how little i show it: the showing-vs-feeling gap is the identity wound.
interp.contradiction.what i've walked away from: the leaving was right AND cost something irrecoverable. live grief.
interp.contradiction.what i keep going back to: self-aware repetition. they know it's not great. probably the fork.
